description: One E2E run: result, failures, tests, and run info.

panels.title: Where this run's time went
panels.description: This run's phases: the wait for a runner, then each group of workflow steps (in every job). A merge-queue run has one bar per suite. Population: this run's jobs and steps, from the job timeline GitHub reported. Time: this run, from its first job's creation to its last job's end. Unit: duration.

panels.title: Time to result
panels.description: From GitHub creating the run's first job to its last job finishing, per suite. Population: this run's jobs and steps, from the job timeline GitHub reported. Time: this run, from its first job's creation to its last job's end. Unit: duration.

panels.title: Waited for a runner
panels.description: Time the run's E2E job waited for a self-hosted runner, per suite. Population: this run's jobs and steps, from the job timeline GitHub reported. Time: this run, from its first job's creation to its last job's end. Unit: duration.

defaults.noValue: No stored jobs for this run.
No stored step timings for this run. Steps are collected for new runs only.

panels.title: All tests
panels.description: Setup, waiting for the product, test actions and teardown add up to the test's duration (from the trace).

defaults.noValue: No pod samples in this range
No pod CPU samples in this range

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_pod_name) (k8s_pod_cpu_usage{osac_ci_capture_id="$capture_id"}) and on (k8s_pod_name) topk(10, sum by (k8s_pod_name) (avg_over_time(k8s_pod_cpu_usage{osac_ci_capture_id="$capture_id"}[$__range] @ end())))

defaults.noValue: No pod memory samples in this range

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_pod_name) (k8s_pod_memory_working_set_bytes{osac_ci_capture_id="$capture_id"}) and on (k8s_pod_name) topk(10, sum by (k8s_pod_name) (avg_over_time(k8s_pod_memory_working_set_bytes{osac_ci_capture_id="$capture_id"}[$__range] @ end())))

panels.title: Waits, fixtures and the step timeline
Waits
panels.description: Every poll_until wait of the run: what it waited for, how long, and whether it timed out. Population: this run's trace. Time: this run, from its first job's creation to its last job's end. Unit: duration and count.

panels.title: Fixture setups
panels.description: Every fixture setup of the run, the slowest first. Population: this run's trace. Time: this run, from its first job's creation to its last job's end. Unit: duration.

panels.title: Step timeline
panels.description: Every step of the run's jobs in order, with when it started after the first job was created. Population: this run's jobs and steps, from the job timeline GitHub reported. Time: this run, from its first job's creation to its last job's end. Unit: duration.
